name: SB10k
description: In this paper we present SB10k, a new corpus for sentiment analysis with approx. 10,000 German tweets. We use this new corpus and two existing corpora to provide state-of-the-art benchmarks for sentiment analysis in German: we implemented a CNN (based on the winning system of SemEval-2016) and a feature-based SVM and compare their performance on all three corpora. For the CNN, we also created German word embeddings trained on 300M tweets. These word embeddings were then optimized for sentiment analysis using distant-supervised learning. The new corpus, the German word embeddings (plain and optimized), and source code to re-run the benchmarks are publicly available.
reputation: Well-regarded within German NLP/sentiment-analysis research as a public German tweet corpus, but not as widely used as major English sentiment datasets.
notes: Approximately 10k German tweets (small dataset), domain-specific (Twitter), includes provided embeddings and code; not an LLM-specific benchmark. Possible sampling/temporal biases and limited size can affect generalization.
